evals.name: kuo-force-dispatch
evals.expected_output: Bumps rust-version in box/kubernetes/kubernetes-upgrade-operator/Cargo.toml, README badge, and the workflow build-binaries toolchain pin to 1.96.0; keeps Dockerfile version label, Cargo version, and Chart.yaml unchanged; commit `[kuo] chore(deps): bump Rust to 1.96.0`; dispatches `gh workflow run _release-rust-scratch-containers.yml -f project=kuo -f force=true` (project value kuo, source dir kubernetes-upgrade-operator); deletes nothing from GHCR.

evals.name: aurora-single-version-force
evals.prompt: aurora-database-insights-exporter rust 버전 1.96.0으로 bump 하고 문서 업데이트 후 재릴리즈
evals.expected_output: Bumps Cargo.toml rust-version and README badge to 1.96.0; commit convention correct; does not delete the GHCR package even though it has only one tagged version, uses the force dispatch with project=aurora-database-insights-exporter instead; skips the local fmt/clippy loop for a toolchain-only bump.

evals.name: ij-cli-only-scope
evals.expected_output: Bumps box/tools/ij/Cargo.toml rust-version to 1.96.0; commit convention correct; recognizes ij is CLI-only (no Dockerfile) so there is NO container re-release via the scratch-container workflow — bump + commit only, optionally a tagged CLI release. Does not invent a GHCR deletion or container workflow trigger.
